independent_checks: Independently derived and parsed all 95 numeric cells in the three five-row project guide tables. All match exact Fraction calculations from primitive equations; this checks literal manuscript tables as well as the previously reviewed program outputs.

Domestic public interest 4 H is included once through composite consumption intercept 55/4 = 43/4 + (3/4)*4. Foreign interest is 5 H. Hence C=10+(3/5)Y; private saving Y-T-5+4-C and public saving T-G-4 sum to national saving Y-5-C-G. Private saving minus investment equals Delta domestic public debt plus CA.

Goods-market denominator 1/2+100 psi is positive for psi>=0; unique linear-system candidate has nonnegative activity in all five cases. Multipliers 2 and 10/7 were independently checked with exact 1/3 H purchases perturbations. Candidate existence does not imply funding approval or a welfare optimum.

The public cash bridge retains 4 interest and 50 maturities at their fixed contracts; the real investment-financing rate is a separate behavioral rate. The purchases-offset candidate requires issuance 54 exceeding capacity 50 by 4. Negative real feedback rate -3/350 does not violate a nominal-rate floor or reprice the old contracts.

For fixed-rate investment-shock scenarios, Y=120+2G, primary surplus=24-(3/5)G, issuance=30+(3/5)G. Thus the nonnegative-G domestic feasibility interval ends at 100/3. Seven exact probes include both sides of the G=25 external-loan kink and the G=100/3 public-cap boundary.

The G=100/3 repair gives Y=560/3, C=122, I=20, M=56/3, T=112/3, primary surplus 4, debt 100, issuance 50, debt/Y=15/28, CA=19/3 and needed official loan 5/6 F. It satisfies the domestic cap but still requires prospective foreign funding and fails to restore output 200. The manuscript states these limits.

External cash payments include old principal 20 F and interest 5/2 F once each. Only interest enters CA. Reserves and external private debt are explicitly consolidated with unrestricted within-account transfer; home public debt stays resident-to-resident. At unchanged e=2, asset and liability transaction differences equal CA and Delta NFA in every case.

Historical transformations preserve rounding and horizons: quarter real growth approximately 0.570106%; annualized implied deflator 200/93%; constant-month CPI hypothetical approximately 4.907021%; rounded household-ratio estimate 4.0%; Q2 revision -8.2, same-release Q3 change -35.9 and mixed-vintage change -44.1 billion USD. Hypothetical participation 0.625 and employment-population 0.5996 imply unemployment 127/3125, correctly rounding to the three reported one-decimal percentages without inventing actual counts.

All four oral prompts were reviewed. Fixed-weight versus Fisher requires aggregation weights, not a welfare inference. Removing the A2(a) borrowing cap restores (50,50) before/after the equal-PV tax shift with saving -20 and -16. Corrected bank borrowing leaves equity -1. Closing-only FX revaluation uses the final net foreign position -19/2 F, giving valuation -19/10 H and NFA -209/10 H while transaction CA remains 5.

All six retention solutions were independently recomputed, including log-utility positivity/boundary derivatives, one-transition geometric duration, balance-sheet loss/borrowing separation, asset-versus-primary-spending classification and tariff surplus assumptions.

Project component weights 25+30+15+15+15 and all nested allocations sum to 100. The 85 overall/75% per-component thresholds are explicit authored choices. Retention 51/60 is 85%, with 7.5/10 in each item; fractional marks are consistent with stated scoring. Oral satisfaction requires the changed assumption, implication and limitation. Critical errors require repair regardless of total.

Read all remediation/index/synthesis text. Coverage maps actual chapter domains and separately reviewed Form A/B item locations; B1(c,d) routes support diffusion, residuals and instrument identification.
